start_position: Dumbbells in front of the thighs, elbows slightly bent
Lean forward slightly, hips and knees slightly bent
concentric: Raise the upper arms out to the sides, elbows pointing back
Stop when the elbows reach shoulder height
top_hold: Elbows directly out to the sides, forearms angled slightly forward
eccentric: Lower slowly back in front of the thighs

validation_profile.comment: Thresholds for automated checks. They catch defects in the animation data (jumps, slides, penetration, asymmetry). They do not certify exercise technique; that needs a qualified human.
validation_profile.max_hand_into_bar_comment: The skin of the palm is rigid in this rig. Up to 8 mm of palm pad inside the bar stands for soft tissue pressed flat by the load; more than that, or any finger passing through the bar, is a defect.
validation_profile.max_elbow_medial_comment: Lateral raise starts with the dumbbells in front of the thighs (ExRx), so the elbows sit inside the shoulder line at the bottom by design.

technical_cues: Lead with the elbows, keep them slightly bent
Raise to shoulder height only; do not shrug
Palms face the floor at the top; do not turn the thumbs up
common_mistakes: Raising the hands above the elbows
Swinging the weights with the trunk
Raising the arms in front instead of out to the sides
muscle_roles_note: Target lateral deltoid; synergists anterior deltoid, middle/lower trapezius, serratus anterior (supraspinatus is hidden under the trapezius); upper trapezius and wrist extensors stabilize. Checked against ExRx 15/11 (Kiệt: "nhóm cơ hoạt động đã chính xác chưa").
